_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). Both declared tests MUST fail with AssertionErrors on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: boolean cell (t="b") in email column is silently accepted as text and flagged only as invalid email
expectedRed.why: On correct code the cell-type check rejects the boolean cell with a structured invalidCell before email validation, so the expected `invalidEmail: '1'` shape differs and the assertion fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the cell-type check is missing or was weakened.

expectedRed.testName: formula error cell (t="e") in email column is silently accepted as text and flagged only as invalid email
expectedRed.why: On correct code the cell-type check rejects the formula-error cell with a structured invalidCell before email validation, so the expected `invalidEmail: '#REF!'` shape differs and the assertion fails with an AssertionError. If this test passes, the cell-type check is missing or was weakened.
